ctx.x: Mancy Johnson, a great drummer. He and he played with was a drummer in this particular band, Fats Waller.

Okay. "To summarize"-- I'm quoting here --"there were five essentially different groups which accepted engagements either using Fletcher Henderson's name or implying his sponsorship." Here's one, "Fletcher Henderson and his Rainbow Orchestra, led by violinist Ellsworth Reynolds, spring 1925 into 1926." Does this mean anything to you? I couldn't quite understand it.
